title: RuntimeRestoreCandidates
description: GET /v2/runtimes/restore-candidates → restoreCandidates; DELETE /v2/runtimes/restore-candidates → restoreDismissed (capability runtime-restore-candidates). Agents whose runtime was online (owner intent, kept until a requested offline / close) when the previous Management run or host stopped uncleanly. Restore = cutex/runtime/online per agent; nothing starts automatically.

lastOnlineAt.description: When the runtime last went online, RFC 3339.

uncleanSince.description: When a Management start found the intended runtimes offline; null when nothing is to restore.

items.description: Still offline, not archived; an agent brought online again leaves the list.

dismissed.description: Offline candidates whose online intent was dropped.
